=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:173-175 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: since_lines() treats an entry as "added by the wave judge" when it has no `title` key (`judge_added = "title" not in entry`), but no production writer of `state.waves[].issues[]` ever sets `title`, so every entry looks like a judge addition.
  WHY: With PERSIST_ORCH_CONTEXT_ENABLED=true, every earlier-wave item, merged or not, is labelled "(added by the wave judge)". Non-merged items also skip the merged-only filter. Later-wave issue bodies therefore state false provenance, and the extra lines fill the 4 KiB cap and push out real merged-item lines. Tests miss this because every fixture (TWO_MERGED, `_state(...)`, `_pos_run`) adds `"title"`. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:497-519 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The optional staging loop for orchestrator-context helpers (persist_orchestrator.py, evidence_pack.py, attempt_journal.py, targeted_file_context.py, gh_api_retry.py) is not gated on PERSIST_ORCH_CONTEXT_ENABLED.
  WHY: With the switch off, every decomposer run still installs or overwrites these helpers from the support ref, adds .gitignore entries in consumer repos, and introduces helper-version drift. This breaks the rule "With the variable off, the PR must be production-safe and change no existing behaviour". Severity disagreement: gemini and minimax said MAJOR, anthropic and glm said NIT; the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19784 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The optional `pos_details_file` expansion in the `rm -f` cleanup command is unquoted.
  WHY: ShellCheck is reported as failing on this change, and a path containing whitespace (for example RUNNER_TEMP) would be word-split, so cleanup could miss the temp file or hit unintended paths. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly did not adopt this, saying CI runs shellcheck with `--severity=error` and the idiom is info or warning level at most.
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:(multiple lines; ci.yml:377 ruff, ci.yml:423-455 shellcheck) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate attributes ruff and shellcheck lint failures, plus six contract-test failures, to this change, centred on the new persist_orchestrator.py and the edits to the workflow staging lists.
  WHY: The gate fails on every push and blocks the pipeline. Each attributed failure has to be reproduced with the exact CI commands and either fixed or shown to be stale attribution. The specific violation sites are unconfirmed. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly did not adopt the ruff, shellcheck or six test attributions, finding no concrete E or F violation and no failure path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:since_lines(): `judge_added = "title" not in entry` followed by `if status != "merged" and not judge_added: continue` and `line += " (added by the wave judge)"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Judge-added detection relies on the state entry lacking a `title` key. No real writer sets `title`: scripts/orchestrate_lib.py lines 1116-1125 and 3064-3072, and orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 9724, 9760, 21918, 31944 and 31980 all omit it. `title` exists only in `pending_issue_defs` (orchestrate_lib.py lines 1143 and 3090).
  WHY: With PERSIST_ORCH_CONTEXT_ENABLED=true, every earlier-wave item gets the "(added by the wave judge)" label, and non-merged items are listed with their status. Wave-2 bodies built at orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 32191 and 27805 therefore state false provenance and fill the 4096-byte cap. The fixtures TWO_MERGED, `_state(...)` and `_pos_run` all add `"title"`. Suggested fix: write a `"persist_judge_added": true` marker at lines 31980 and 31944, test for that marker, and add a fixture shaped like real state.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:lines 505-518, the loop `for f in persist_orchestrator.py evidence_pack.py attempt_journal.py targeted_file_context.py gh_api_retry.py; do ... install -m 0755 "${src}" "scripts/${f}"; _fetched_scripts+=("${f}")` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The staging loop runs on every decomposer run, whatever PERSIST_ORCH_CONTEXT_ENABLED is set to, although its only consumer is the gated "Build persistence context (P7)" step.
  WHY: With the switch off, five extra executables are still copied in, the generated scripts/.gitignore (lines 586-591) gains five entries, and tracked copies in the source repo are overwritten. This departs from "change no existing behaviour". Gating on `[ "${PERSIST_ORCH_CONTEXT_ENABLED:-false}" = "true" ]` fixes it.

  Evidence of absence: ci.yml lines 671-673 run only test_persist_postmerge_verify.py, test_persist_budget.py and test_evidence_pack.py. The static-checks job (run 41261740399, job 124716223967) fails `tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py::test_every_test_file_runs_in_a_workflow` with `assert not ['tests/test_persist_orchestrator.py']`. ci.yml is not in the files_touched grant, and an UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST entry would only hide the failure.

- HARDENING | .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml, step "Build persistence context (P7)", the `python3 -B scripts/persist_orchestrator.py open-projects` call | risk=1
  PROBLEM: There is no timeout-minutes on the step and no `timeout` wrapper on the call. gh_api_retry.call can sleep up to 600 s per attempt for 3 attempts, about 30 minutes.
  WHY: This could stall the decomposer before "Build Codex prompt", and continue-on-error does not shorten the wait. Fix: prefix the call with `timeout 120` or add `timeout-minutes: 10` (1 line).
